paleography.balinese_transcription: ᭞᭐᭞ ᬑᬁ ᬰ᭄ᬭᬷ ᭞ ᬢᬸᬢᬸᬃ ᬓ, ᬳᬧᬦ᭄ ᬳᬦᬓ᭄ ᬢᬦ᭄ ᬯ᭄ᬭᬸ, ᬩ᭄ᬭᬳ᭄ᬫᬡ᭄ᬬ ᬤᬾᬯ ᬲᬗ᭄ᬓᭂᬧ᭄, ᬧᬳᬫᭂᬲᬦ᭄ᬓ᭄ᬯ, ᬤᬾᬯᬦ᭄ ᬧ᭄ᬭᬢ᭄ᬬᬓ᭄ᬱ, ᬢᬸᬢᬸᬃ ᬯᬾᬤ᭄ᬬ, ᬧᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬾᬄ ᬫᬳᬶᬦ᭄ᬤ᭄ᬭ, ᬧᬳᬯᭂᬲ᭄ᬫᬳᬶᬦ᭄ᬤ᭄ᬭ, ᬫᬳᬧᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬾᬄ, ᬲᬫᬦ᭄ᬢ᭄ᬭ᭄ᬬ, ᬱ᭄ᬝ ᬧᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬾᬄ, ᬧᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬾᬄ ᬧᬲ᭄ᬢ᭄ᬭᬂ ᬤᬾᬯ ᬲᬗ᭄ᬓᭂᬧ᭄, ᬬᬤ᭄ᬬᬧᬶ ᬧᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬾᬄ ᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬄ ᬧ᭄ᬭᬢ᭄ᬬᬓ᭄ᬱ ᬓᬾᬯᬮ, ᬧᬢᬶᬗ᭄ᬓᬾᬄ ᬅᬧᬤ ᭞ ᬬᬗ᭄ ᬢᭀᬮᭀᬮᬶᬓ᭄ ᬯ᭄ᬭᬹᬄ ᬳᬫᭂᬢ᭄ ᬩᬧᬓᬦ᭄ ᬫᬦᬸᬱ᭄ᬬ ᬧᬦ᭄ᬤᬶᬢ
paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
1. // oṁ śrī / tutur ka, apan anak tan wru, brahmaṇya dewa saṅkĕp, pahamĕsankwa, dewan pratyakṣa, tutur wedya, patiṅkeh mahi- 
2. ndra, pahawĕs mahindra, mahapatiṅkeh, samantrya, ṣṭa patiṅkeh, patiṅkeh pastraṅ dewa saṅkĕp, yadyapi patiṅkeh tiṅkah 
3. pratyakṣa kewala, patiṅkeh apada / yaṅ tololik wruḥ amet bapakan manuṣya pandita /
paleography.indonesian_translation: Om Sri. Ajaran tutur..., sebab seseorang tidak mengetahui, Brahmana dewa sangkep... dewa yang nyata, ajaran wedya, aturan Mahendra... aturan yang nyata belaka, tingkatan ajaran...
paleography.english_translation: Om Sri. The tutur teachings..., because a person does not know, the divine Brahmana assembly... the visible deity, knowledge teachings, the order of Mahendra... merely visible rules, the order of...

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Teks memuat ajaran tutur keagamaan/filosofis dan tata aturan ritual/dewa (tutur wedya), tidak memuat resep atau instruksi pengobatan tanaman herbal.

[Lembar 1]
// om, astu astu, ngaraning, hanusangcaya, yan ananghi rehningkare, 
panasangse, rengatpratingkare, nguni hanglih, bakti luwih, bala
wanjarangsingkare, yapuanangsingkiti, ngle, 
lan hanangbida, malasabakti, ranangse, mputinadi, baktiluwe
ngangkara, meduyangkasiyabanbakti, resansang, radadane
prangprangsangbanti, baktiluwanangkara. // 0 // yapuanlaraduta
ranangsangrohanangsinawelembang, ramangkulanglang, 0 
ripanangsayangkayewanapannawa, paningsingsulangkara. //
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Semoga ada keselamatan. Mengenai hanusangcaya, jika bangkit perbuatannya, panas duka nestapa, rengat tingkah lakunya, sejak dahulu lelah, berbakti utama, tentara/kekuatan... dan jika timbul keraguan, serta ada perbedaan, terpisah baktinya, mengalami kesulitan... pengabdian yang luhur... Jika penyakit/kondisi berlanjut...
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
May there be auspiciousness. Concerning hanusangcaya, if actions arise, heat of affliction, fractured behavior, long weary, supreme devotion, host/power... and if doubt arises, and there is division, separated devotion... supreme devotion... If the condition/messenger of illness continues...

paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
ti, titiyang taru soka, don titiyang panes, akah titiyang panes, dados tamban tiwang brahma, loloh
nyane akah titiyang, babakan titiyang anggen boreh, dados tamban tiwang bangke, uyah areng,
laos, mica, temutis, titiyang taru kelor, don titiyang dumelada, akah titiyang panes,
sukar matemu, don titiyang dados loloh tamban tiwang brahma,

titang taru kelor, don titiyang tis, akah titiyang dumelada,
wah, anggen loloh, anggen boreh, akah titiyang dados tamban tiwang brahma, dados tamban tiwang bangke,
boreh nyane temu tis, [tidak terbaca], uyah areng, laos, mica, temutis,
kasurat olih, I Wayan Suta, banjar Brahmana, Gianyar.
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
..., hamba pohon soka, daun hamba berkhasiat hangat/panas, akar hamba hangat/panas, dapat dijadikan obat tiwang brahma, ramuan minumnya
adalah akar hamba, kulit kayu hamba digunakan sebagai boreh (balur), dapat menjadi obat tiwang bangke, (campurannya) garam arang,
laos (lengkuas), merica, temu tis. Hamba pohon kelor, daun hamba bersifat sedang, akar hamba hangat/panas,
sukar bertemu, daun hamba dapat dijadikan loloh (jamu) obat tiwang brahma,

hamba pohon kelor, daun hamba dingin, akar hamba sedang,
... digunakan sebagai loloh, digunakan sebagai boreh, akar hamba dapat menjadi obat tiwang brahma, dapat menjadi obat tiwang bangke,
borehnya temu tis, [tidak terbaca], garam arang, laos, merica, temu tis,
ditulis oleh I Wayan Suta, Banjar Brahmana, Gianyar.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
..., I am the soka tree, my leaves are warm/hot, my roots are warm/hot, can be used as medicine for tiwang brahma, the potion
is my roots, my bark is used as a boreh (poultice), can be a medicine for tiwang bangke, (with adjuvants) charcoal salt,
galangal, black pepper, temu tis. I am the kelor tree, my leaves are neutral/moderate, my roots are warm/hot,
difficult to encounter, my leaves can be made into a potion (loloh) for tiwang brahma,

I am the kelor tree, my leaves are cool, my roots are neutral,
... used as a drink, used as a boreh, my roots can cure tiwang brahma, can cure tiwang bangke,
the poultice includes temu tis, [unreadable], charcoal salt, galangal, black pepper, temu tis,
written by I Wayan Suta, Banjar Brahmana, Gianyar.

... tityang pinaka ... raksa ... mangda sang maraga panutan ... punika sami, mangda prasida ngamargiang kaweruhan ...
... mangda sida kapangguh, rahayu lan landuh ring sajeroning jagat ... mangda sami nemu rahayu ...
... ring sajeroning manah, mangda tulus asih, tan wenten kapiambeng ... prasida rahayu ... mangda sami ...
... ngardi jagat ... mangda paripurna ... mangda prasida shanti ...
paleography.indonesian_translation: Teks memuat doa, petuah moral, atau wejangan keutamaan budi pekerti (filosofis/etika) agar memperoleh keselamatan, ketentraman (rahayu), serta kedamaian (shanti) dalam kehidupan dan pikiran yang tulus asih tanpa rintangan.
paleography.english_translation: The text contains prayers, moral guidance, or ethical teachings aiming to achieve peace, safety (rahayu), and harmony (shanti) in life and a sincere mind without obstacles.
